title: 25 北剑玄女1226 大战之前22
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 琉璃寺深夜...
僧门尽关。
然而，大雄宝殿里，一名江湖客却在知客僧指引下焚香拜佛。
江湖客什么都没说。
只不过，他的香火却已说明了一切。
这江湖客祈福的内容是：平安。
但他不是祈福自己平安，而是为另一个人祈福。
那是他们的首领...
香火中，慈喜和李玄都看的分明。
红衣佳人，手握金色量衣软尺，素手纤纤，可惜...眼缠红绫，是个瞎子。
那江湖客正是祈福此女平安。
他摘了斗笠，露出满脸风霜的胡渣脸。
“我刘二虽不知此行究竟为何，也不知庄老板又为何要派我连夜赶来琉璃寺拜佛，可我知道一定是有什么大事要发生了。
我的命是庄老板给的，我的老母是庄老板花钱葬的。此番无论是何事，只求佛陀保佑，哪怕小人身死，也愿庄老板平安。”
高处...
慈喜道：“斥候来了。”
李玄问：“何以见得？”
慈喜道：“此女名为庄晓梦，江湖一流高手，十年前她以一把软剑横行北地，所向披靡，得了个北剑玄女的称号。
五年前，她却在风头最盛的时候消失了...看来，是隐姓埋名当了位老板，庄老板。
只是十年前，她的眼睛可不瞎，如今既然瞎了，那实力怕不是也削弱了几分。
她一定是河帮三公子的人，这是探路来了。
至于那刘二想来是庄晓梦的手下，只不过地位太低并不知道自己到底是来做什么的，他只负责来烧香拜佛，然后把所见所闻汇报回去。”
说罢，稍息。
慈喜感慨一声：“这些江湖中人，总是你想着为我而死，我想着为他而死，那庄晓梦要为三公子崔沧澜探路，这刘二愿为庄晓梦而死...
师弟，过往他化就会折寿。如今，你我一粒仙丹吞下肚，不折寿了，但每次却也只能他化一人。香火错过便是错过，机不可失，师兄还需等待那三公子......此番，就劳烦师弟了。”
李玄颔首。
能够获得探索世界的机会，这本也是他所求。
一口香火吞尽，灵台空明，反刍而去。
刷！
无形光点没入那刘二躯体。
李玄刚开始还担心对方是练家子，自己这“他化”不够格，但真“他化”了过去，才意识到...是不是练家子真没区别。
那一粒神秘丹药，已经把他的精神提升到了一个颇为强大的地步，哪怕对方是武者，也无法抗拒。
content_en:
Late night at Liuli Temple...
The monks are closed.
However, in the main hall, a Jianghu guest burned incense and worshiped Buddha under the guidance of Zhike monk.
The charlatan said nothing.
However, his incense said it all.
The content of this charlatan’s prayer is: peace.
But he was not praying for his own safety, but for another person.
That's their leader...
In the incense, Cixi and Li Xuan both saw it clearly.
The beauty in red is holding a golden measuring ruler. She has slender hands. Unfortunately... her eyes are wrapped in red silk, and she is blind.
The charlatan was praying for this woman's safety.
He took off his bamboo hat, revealing a weathered and bearded face.
"Although I, Liu Er, don't know the reason for this trip, and I don't know why Boss Zhuang sent me to come to Liuli Temple overnight to worship Buddha, I know that something big is going to happen.
My life was given by Boss Zhuang, and my mother was buried by Boss Zhuang at his expense. No matter what happens this time, I just ask for the Buddha's blessing. Even if I die, I hope the owner of the village is safe. "
High places...
Ci said happily: "The scouts are here."
Li Xuan asked: "How can we see it?"
Cixi said happily: "This girl's name is Zhuang Xiaomeng, a top-notch master in the world. Ten years ago, she used a soft sword to run rampant in the North. She was invincible and earned the title of the Mysterious Lady of the North Sword.
Five years ago, she disappeared at the height of her popularity... It seemed that she had become a boss, Boss Zhuang, incognito.
It's just that ten years ago, her eyes were not blind. Now that she is blind, her strength may have been weakened a bit.
She must be from the Third Young Master of the River Gang, and she is here to explore the way.
As for Liu Er, I think he was Zhuang Xiaomeng's subordinate, but his status was too low and he didn't know what he was doing. He was only responsible for burning incense and worshiping Buddha, and then reporting back what he saw and heard. "
Having said that, take a rest.
Ci Xi sighed with emotion: "These people in the world, you always want to die for me, I want to die for him, Zhuang Xiaomeng wants to explore the way for the third son Cui Canglan, Liu Er is willing to die for Zhuang Xiaomeng...
Junior brother, if you transform into someone else in the past, your life span will be shortened. Now, if you and I swallow a pill of elixir, we will live longer, but we can only transform into one person at a time. If you miss the incense, you will miss it. The opportunity cannot be missed. Senior brother still has to wait for the third young master... This time, I will trouble my junior brother. "
Li Xuan nodded.
Being able to get the opportunity to explore the world was what he wanted.
After swallowing the incense in one mouthful, the spiritual platform was empty, and he chewed the cud and left.
brush!
Invisible light points disappeared into Liu Er's body.
At first, Li Xuangang was worried that the other party was Lian Jiazi and that his "other transformation" was not qualified. But after he really "othered" him, he realized...it really didn't make any difference whether he was Lian Jiazi or not.
That mysterious pill has raised his spirit to a very powerful level, and even if the opponent is a warrior, he cannot resist it.
